title: Sorted binary search
blurb: Check the bounds and termination carefully — is anything actually broken?
prompt: Review this Python binary search for a sorted ascending list `nums`. Flag any bug, or mark it clean if it holds up.
conclusion: AI summary: Returns the index of `target` in sorted `nums`, or -1 if absent (including empty and 1-element lists).
clean_conclusion: The inclusive `[lo, hi]` invariant holds on every iteration: empty lists exit immediately, 1-element lists check index 0, and every branch strictly shrinks the interval.
